1. import { T, always, cond, juxt, test, when } from 'ramda'
2. import { resolveJobDuration } from './utils'
3. 
4. // resolveStatusCodeFromError :: String -> Integer
5. const resolveStatusCodeFromError = cond([
6.   [error => test(/timeout/i, error), always(504)],
7.   [error => test(/timed out/i, error), always(504)],
8.   [T, always(500)],
9. ])
10. 
11. // jobFailedHandler :: (Logger, Queue, RequestRegistry) -> Function
12. export default (logger, queue, requestRegistry) => (jobId, error) => when(
13.   jobId => requestRegistry.has(jobId),
14.   juxt([
15.     jobId => requestRegistry.fail(
16.       jobId,
17.       resolveStatusCodeFromError(error),
18.     ),
19.     async jobId => {
20.       const job = await queue.getJob(jobId)
21. 
22.       logger.error(`${jobId} ${job.data.url} ${resolveStatusCodeFromError(error)} ${resolveJobDuration(job)} ${error}`)
23. 
24.       job.remove()
25.     },
26.   ]),
27. )(jobId)
28.

1. import render from '../renderers/chrome'
2. 
3. // isJobExpired :: (Configuration, Job) -> Boolean
4. const isJobExpired = (configuration, job) =>
5.   Date.now() - job.data.queuedAt > configuration.queue.job.stale_timeout
6. 
7. // queueProcessHandler :: (Configuration, Logger, ScriptProvider) -> Function
8. export default (configuration, logger, scriptProvider) => async job => {
9.   if (isJobExpired(configuration, job)) {
10.     throw new Error(`Job "${job.id}" with url "${job.data.url}" timed out."`)
11.   }
12. 
13.   logger.debug(`Processing job "${job.id}" with url "${job.data.url}".`)
14. 
15.   return await render(configuration, logger, scriptProvider)(job.data.url)
16. }
17.

- fix(queue): whenCurrentJobsFinished shouldn't initialize bclient. Fixes #1346.
- fix(queue): unhandled promise warning in updateDelayTimer.
- fix(sandbox): if the child process is killed, remove it from the pool.

- fix: remove logs automtically when using autoremove fixes #1330
